releaseNotes: v1.8.2: Code moved to the main package folder. No functional changes. v1.8.1: Battery voltage curve tuned for CR2 lithium cells (the old curve was for CR2450/CR2477 coin cells). Default battery reporting interval changed from 60 to 240 minutes for steadier Battery Monitor drain readings.
author: jdthomas24

drivers.name: SmartThings Motion Sensor Enhanced
drivers.description: SmartThings Zigbee motion sensor: motion, temperature and battery, processed locally, with a battery curve tuned for CR2 cells.
